deprecated_reason: At 124M GPT-2 / 2.5B Chinchilla-optimal tokens, no Titans variant we tried (v4_fast, v4b_fast TBPTT=8, v5a slow-decay, v5b strong-write, v5c combo, v5d 4k-train-ctx) beats vanilla on the headline OOD long-context retrieval (NIAH at 2× train ctx: vanilla=0.625 vs best Titans v4b_fast=0.250). Titans wins on val_loss + retrieval up to 1.5× train ctx, but the whole point of test-time-trained memory is to extrapolate further than vanilla — and at this scale it doesn't. Deprecated 2026-05-03 pending either (a) a substrate that actually beats vanilla at 2×+ train ctx, or (b) a larger-scale (350M+) sweep where the substrate's scaling story might emerge.
